sources.title: OLMo from Ai2
sources.snippet: OLMo 2 32B is the most capable and largest model in the OLMo 2 family, scaling up the OLMo 2 training recipe used for our 7B and 13B models. It is trained up to 6T tokens and post-trained using Tulu 3.1. OLMo 2 32B is the first fully-open model to outperform GPT3.5-Turbo and GPT-4o mini on a suite of popular, multi-skill academic benchmarks.
